exposure: Neonatal outcomes by maternal COVID-19 severity
cohort: 257 pregnant women with COVID-19 and their 62 newborns
finding: Gestational age at COVID-19 diagnosis and parity were significant risk factors for severe COVID-19 in pregnant women, but vertical transmission was not observed, and maternal severity did not significantly impact neonatal prognosis.
mod_finding: Among women who delivered, 78.5% underwent cesarean section.
gest_age: Most patients developed COVID-19 during the third trimester
